title: SimPy: Simulating Real-World Processes With Python
description: Use the SimPy package to model real-world processes in Python, then design and run a simulation that shows where a system gets congested.
summary: The real world is full of systems, like airports and highways, that frequently experience congestion and delay. When these systems are not optimized, their inefficiency can lead to countless unhappy customers and hours of wasted time.
takeaways: In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to: Use a simulation to model a real-world process Create a step-by-step algorithm to approximate a complex system Design and run a real-world simulation in Python with simpy In this tutorial, you’ll create a simulation for a local movie theater.
One can use mathematical or computational models of this system to study how it works, or what happens when parts of it are changed.
In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to use Python’s simpy framework to create virtual simulations that will help you solve problems like these.
